correctness.rationale: The exact prime-power formula z(p^a)=1+p+...+p^{a-2} gives 0,1,3,4,6,7,8 entries at indicated prime powers. The normalized product rho=z/n increases strictly with each prime exponent on fixed composite support, so nonsquarefree two-support minima reduce to p^2 q or p q^2 with z=q+2p+1 or p+2q+1, uniquely attaining 8 for (p,q)=(2,3), n=12. For squarefree pqr, z=2(p+q+r)>=20, and adjoining a prime raises the gap; repeated powers cannot reduce it. Thus the factorization partition proves the infinite exact fibers and nonoccurrence of 5, not just a finite sieve. Independently computed sigma and phi for n<=100000 and reproduced all six small fibers, corroboratively.
residual_risks: Finite exact checks are bounded and are not substituted for the explicitly reconstructed infinite proof or analytic distribution.
